Name: ACBreakz Board
Author: ACBreakz
Description: Team and highlight keys that mirror the live NFL board. Icons are painted from server state over Supabase Realtime, so they cannot drift from what is on stream.

Actions.Name: Team Key
Actions.Tooltip: One NFL team on one PC. Eliminates or highlights, and always shows what the board actually says.

Actions.Name: Reset Key
Actions.Tooltip: Clears every elimination (or every highlight) on one PC, and puts them all back if pressed again.
